data.description:
## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py:681-684` computes `_sev = severity_label(imp)` and discards it ("keep the call so severity_label stays exercised"); `severity_label` at `:621` is already exercised by `tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py:72-76` and `tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py:104`. `src/rebar/llm/workflow/steps.py:202,208,214,242` still fail the `gate` step on `fail_on_severity` beside the ADR-0108 `priority_threshold` (`:204,210,216,244`); ADR 0108 `:131-136` records this as an unwired sample-only policy, and `fail_on_severity` exists nowhere else (no config key, no `_config_schema.py` entry, no mechanism-baseline row). `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verdict.schema.json:5` says findings carry `severity`; `src/rebar/schemas/gate_input.schema.json:10` says each finding "is an object with a `severity`". `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py:193-208` reads `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` (`:198`, `# read-via: subsystem-kill-switch`) for the story-a9dd A/B, which is finished; the default (unset) path is the `else` branch `:201-208` (prefetch ON). Operator rulings: remove both, with release notes. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
1. `decide.py`: delete `:681-684`.
2. `steps.py`: delete the three `"fail_on_severity"` keys and `:242` (`if finding.get("severity") in policy["fail_on_severity"]: return True`); rewrite the comment at `:195-198` ("fails when any finding's `priority` is at or above the policy's `priority_threshold` or the count exceeds `max_findings`"). `advisory` keeps `priority_threshold: None`.
3. `gate_input.schema.json:10` becomes "each item is an object with a `priority`"; `plan_review_verdict.schema.json:5` drops "`severity`, " from the findings list. Neither string is in the generated `types.py` subset; `python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types --check` proves it.
4. `gate_ops.py`: delete `:193-201` (comment, `import os`, the `if` and its two lines) and the `else:`, dedenting `:202-208`; keep the `prefetch_manifest` name.
5. `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py:64`: delete the `gate_ops.py` row; `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP` at `:67` becomes `3`. `docs/env-vars.md:161` disappears via `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py` (drift gate `.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml:43`). `.github/mechanism-baseline.json:611` `env_var::REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` becomes `stale`; do not hand-edit.
6. `docs/release-notes.md`: "`REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` removed: the completion verifier's file-impact prefetch is always on (the a9dd A/B is finished). The sample `gate` workflow step no longer fails on `severity`; policies key on `priority_threshold` only (ADR 0108)."

## Scope
The files above. Out of scope: `findings.py` `SEVERITIES` vocabulary (ADR 0108 amendment 3), the `completion_*` severity consumers, `severity_label` itself, `mechanism-baseline.json`.

## Testing
`tests/unit/workflow/test_steps.py:29,35,40,46` (severity-driven cases): rewrite to `priority`-driven equivalents (`{"priority": 0.99}` fails default; strict via `max_findings`; advisory never fails; unknown policy falls back), keep `:56-91`. `tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py:78-97` unchanged (asserts no `severity` key, still true). Prefetch tests: `tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py:216` and `tests/unit/workflow/test_child_closure_evidence_6ec8.py:45` replace `monkeypatch.setenv("REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH", "0")` with `monkeypatch.setattr("rebar.llm.workflow.completion_prefetch.assemble_prefetch", lambda spec, *, repo_root: ("", []))` (the idiom at `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch.py:199-202`; `fit_within_ceiling(base, "", model)` returns `""` so context equals base). Add `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch.py::test_precheck_always_prefetches` (spy `assemble_prefetch` called once with `PrefetchSpec(ticket_id, graph)`; both `monkeypatch.delenv("REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH", raising=False)` and `setenv(..., "0")` still call it).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n "fail_on_severity\|REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH\|severity_label(imp)" -- src tests docs scripts .github ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!.github/mechanism-baseline.json'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py && git diff --exit-code docs/env-vars.md` is clean and the file has no `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` row.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` with `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` listed under stale.
- [ ] `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` is green with `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP == 3`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Remove severity residue from gate policies (ADR 0108) and the finished REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH A/B switch
